verdict.rationale: Zep publishes a specific claimed latency target ('sub-200ms context retrieval regardless of graph size or number of graphs') repeated across docs, which is more concrete than typical vague speed marketing. However, this is a single headline claim, not a documented methodology, benchmark suite, or measured p50/p95 breakdown, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the number. Missing for 10: p50/p95 or percentile breakdowns, benchmark methodology/dataset details, independent verification of the 200ms claim.
